subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: Help me understand what's worth analyzing and actionable in these expense records.

judge.implied_focus: Characterizing IT asset/procurement expenses by what was purchased and the data-quality/provenance of each record

per_column.name: asset_category
per_column.rationale: Directly typologizes the purchased asset (hardware/cloud/software/travel), a core facet of what the expense is for.

per_column.name: asset_brand
per_column.rationale: Vendor/brand dimension of the asset, a coherent attribute for spend analysis.

per_column.name: travel_related
per_column.rationale: Flags a distinct spend category; complements asset_category, mild redundancy with travel_equipment.

per_column.name: procurement_action_type
per_column.rationale: Classifies the procurement lifecycle action, a meaningful facet of expense type.

per_column.name: entry_origin
per_column.rationale: Provenance/data-quality facet (manual vs auto), useful for judging record reliability.

per_column.name: has_source_id
per_column.rationale: Data-completeness flag; supports the data-quality sub-theme but is somewhat mechanical.

per_column.name: ci_identifier_quality
per_column.rationale: Assesses quality of the CI identifier, a genuine actionable data-quality dimension.

per_column.name: repeat_user_flag
per_column.rationale: Behavioral flag tied to users; loosely related but drifts from the asset/data-quality core (near-constant at 486/14).

judge.rationale: The columns cluster around two related but distinguishable themes: (1) what the expense purchased (asset_category, asset_brand, travel_related, procurement_action_type) and (2) the quality/provenance of the record (entry_origin, has_source_id, ci_identifier_quality). Together they cohere reasonably around 'understanding and enriching IT asset/procurement expense records', giving decent but not tight focus_coherence. The structure is genuinely analytical -- categorical enrichments with useful granularity rather than restatements or token-count noise, and the data-quality facets are directly actionable (fix generic placeholders, review manual entries). Weaknesses: travel_related duplicates a value already inside asset_category, and repeat_user_flag is near-constant (486/14) and thematically peripheral, slightly diluting the single-focus claim. Overall a coherent, actionable inference, not a scattered grab-bag.
